macros.name: acadtitle
macros.doc: \acadtitle expects your academic title(s).

macros.name: addresscity
macros.doc: \addresscity for your city, ZIP Code and possibly your country.

macros.name: addtofooter
macros.doc: The command \addtofooter[⟨symbol⟩]{⟨text⟩} can be used in the new pagestyle definition to add something to the footer. The optional argument expects the symbol to be used as a separator between elements that appear on the same line.

macros.name: cvitem
macros.doc: \cvitem[⟨spacing⟩]{⟨header⟩}{⟨text⟩} is for single pairs of header and text. The header will appear in the hint column, the main text in the main column.

macros.name: cvitem
macros.doc: \cvitem[⟨spacing⟩]{⟨header⟩}{⟨text⟩} is for single pairs of header and text. The header will appear in the hint column, the main text in the main column.

macros.name: cvitemwithcomment
macros.doc: With \cvitemwithcomment[⟨spacing⟩]{⟨header⟩}{⟨text⟩}{⟨comment⟩} you can list a pair of header and description with a additional right-aligned comment.

macros.name: cvitemwithcomment
macros.doc: With \cvitemwithcomment[⟨spacing⟩]{⟨header⟩}{⟨text⟩}{⟨comment⟩} you can list a pair of header and description with a additional right-aligned comment.

macros.name: cvquote
macros.doc: Put your life motto (or something alike) into \cvquote. It will usually appear somewhat separated from the rest of the header.

macros.name: extrainfo
macros.doc: \extrainfo takes any arbitrary additional information and will appear at the end of the addressblock (depending on the chosen style).

macros.name: headline
macros.doc: With \headline[⟨alignment⟩]{⟨type⟩}[⟨content⟩] you can set – guess what? – a headline or title for the whole document, either a title (like “Curriculum vitae”) or your name, which may come in handy if you have a very long name that is otherwise being displayed in an unsatisfying way. The first optional argument sets the alignment (l=left, r=right, c=centered (default)).

macros.name: httplink
macros.doc: The mandatory argument of \httplink will be prefixed with http://, of \httpslink with https://, of \emaillink with mailto:.

macros.name: infocolwidth
macros.doc: In oldstyle style the address and possible extra information are presented in the left margin of the width \infocolwidth. Its default value is 3.5cm.

macros.name: mframepicshift
macros.doc: The length \mframepicshift controls how much the picture will be moved to the right (from the right text margin).

macros.name: photo
macros.doc: With frame as optional argument the picture is set into a frame, by default in the color chosen as document color.

macros.name: totalpagemark
macros.doc: The command \totalpagemark prints the total number of pages.
